Method of Attack: Ransomware attack involving data theft and encryption
Data leak after ransom demand refusal
Targeting corporate networks vulnerable to remote desktop hacks
Date of Discovery: June 2020 (incident in early June, publicly announced mid-June 2020)
Impacted Systems: Lorien Health Services' corporate and nursing home networks
Indicators of Compromise: Screenshots of directory listings with 2020 date stamps and admission records
Password-protected archive of 147MB leaked online with unlock key
Public announcement of breach by Netwalker operators in mid-June 2020
